intelligence.enrichment: Sugar decomposes on heating to give carbon and water; because water consists of hydrogen and oxygen, sugar is a compound containing carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen. Heating breaks sugar into different products, and the products reveal that sugar contains more than one element. The learner correctly applies this rule: Sugar decomposes on heating to give carbon and water; because water consists of hydrogen and oxygen, sugar is a compound containing carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen. If heating leaves one black solid, the original substance was that element.
